mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.account_id AS accountId, a.name, a.role, a.password, c.id AS companyNumericId, c.company_id AS companyCode, c.expiration_date AS expirationDate FROM account a INNER JOIN account_company ac ON a.id = ac.account_id INNER JOIN company c ON ac.company_id = c.id WHERE UPPER(a.account_id) = UPPER(#{accountId}) AND a.status = 'active' AND UPPER(TRIM(c.company_id)) = #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET last_login = NOW() WHERE id = #{accountId}
